note: Popular accounts from the social graph (Instagram follower counts and follow ties, GPU-FDG layout), resolved to Wikidata for lifespans, sex, citizenship and offices. Jev (TypeSafe) judged identity where the handle did not match, person / group / organization, region when citizenship did not settle it, political role, birth decade when Wikidata had none (est = true), and which economy company a capital holder runs. Follower counts are a 2025 snapshot; they size people in every year shown. Brands and outlets are left out. gov lists government offices only ([office, from, to, e(xecutive)|l(egislative), n(ational)|s(tate/local)]); company, honorary and goodwill-ambassador titles are dropped. K-pop and Bollywood stars belong to East and South Asia whatever their citizenship.
sources: Wikidata (CC0): P2003 Instagram username, P31, P569, P570, P571, P576, P21, P27, P106, P39 with P580/P582
